name: Batfish
description: Offline network configuration analysis tool that finds bugs and guarantees correctness of planned or current network configurations. Builds a vendor-neutral model from device configs and performs multi-dimensional analysis (reachability, routing, ACLs, BGP/OSPF sessions) without accessing live devices.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker pull batfish/allinone; docker run --name batfish -v batfish-data:/data -p 8888:8888 -p 9997:9997 -p 9996:9996 batfish/allinone

eval_notes: Offline configuration analysis (no device access needed). Validates security, reliability, compliance. Supports 12+ vendors. Excellent for agentic evaluations involving configuration verification and change impact analysis. Pre-deployment config validation without live devices. Runs in Docker (batfish/allinone). Jupyter notebook interface at port 8888. Requires 8GB RAM minimum, 32GB for production. Complementary to containerlab -- validates configs before deployment.
